requirement_violation: The graph never resolves the Conflicts page's 'Back to <origin>' control, so it cannot show whether that Back is a wrong return. In doc/ux-transition-graph.md:1033-1034 (Dynamic transitions), 'risk · riskConflictsOpen=true | Button: Back to | yes | … state.panel = dynamic; state.projection = dynamic | src/product/KnowledgeGraphApp.tsx:6421' appears only as a dynamic Back. No concrete Back edge leaves s14 in the Screen graph or the Edges table. The value comes from the shell's own captured state, conflictReviewOrigin (KnowledgeGraphApp.tsx:6144 openConfigurationReview → setConflictReviewOrigin({state, facility, learning, …})). It does not come from a child callback or browser history. Cause: kindDimension /(?:Id|Origin)$/ in scripts/ux-transition-graph.mjs normalizes that object to RECORD, so the restore handler at 6421-6434 reads dynamic values. PRD-DEV-UX-GRAPH (doc/product-requirements.md:6392-6409) says 'Every Back edge resolves to a target screen'. It allows dynamic transitions only for 'a value supplied at runtime by a child callback or browser history'. Same clause: 'A mounted Facility choice/conflict/return journey enforces the two-step return through Conflicts to its opening screen.' The generated map can verify only the first step, repair → Conflicts. It cannot verify the second step, Conflicts → opener, which is exactly the return the Origin request (Darafei, 2026-11-05 18:52Z) wanted to see. AGENTS.md says 'A row delivering committed code binds its acceptance artifact to git:<worktree>@<full sha>' and 'Final acceptance runs every assigned key against the final commit; a follow-on commit turns earlier runs into history'. Also, the observation path names the button 'Back to Conflicts', but the spec at e2e/ux-conflict-return.spec.ts:102-125 clicks `setup.getByRole('button', { name: /^Back to / })` and never asserts that label. The recorded label is a claim the spec does not check.

audit.evidence: LandOrbitFix-12 published r2: page HTTP 200, image HTTP 200, probe 200, revision ed8dc324718c
audit.findings:
Checked at HEAD e6eb91a246bbeacf8d39748214804e182eef0c34. The working tree was clean (empty `git status --porcelain`), and Darafei's dev server on port 47362 was serving from /home/kom/proj/sunbim/datacenter-decision-graph.

Defect: the delivered change is not in HEAD.
- The recorded revision ed8dc324718c does not exist in this repository (`fatal: Not a valid object name`). The served review page's `review-revision` meta also says ed8dc324718c.
- The page credits PR 115 and candidate a0b5962dc8c28487bde10d9dabfc3dbd4011f113. That commit exists, but it is not an ancestor of HEAD (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` exited 1). Its own diff only changes the UX transition graph, docs and the uxTransitionGraph test.

The requirements are not met at HEAD:
- R248: 30 fps under contention from a concurrent Google Meet call. The page says itself that "M1 during-call acceptance is not yet established".
- R250: the GPU-bound rotation target of 24 fps. The only result is an x86 proxy with 4× CPU throttle.

The HEAD Facility opens in a headless browser on hardware WebGL (RTX 5070 Ti) at 1440 and 430 widths. A right-drag orbit at 1440 moved the camera, and labels were still painted after it. In the idle state before that orbit, the canvas reported 16 label placement violations, 1 overlapping label and 4 crossing leader lines.

Not run: the HEAD Playwright gate. Two `--list` attempts were refused by the host test-capacity guard (the hardware GPUs had 1687 MiB and 714 MiB free; it needs 2048 MiB free).
